recipes.title: Spicy Garlic Parmesan Chicken Skewers (air fryer)

items.i: boneless skinless chicken thighs, cut into chunks
each paprika, garlic powder, onion powder and dried parsley
fresh parsley, chopped, plus more to serve
grated parmesan, plus more to serve

steps: Toss the chicken with the lemon juice, all the seasonings, oil, salt and pepper.
Thread onto skewers and air fry at about 400°F (200°C) for 8–10 minutes per side until charred and cooked through.
Mix the mayo, sriracha, mustard, garlic, red pepper flakes, parsley, lemon juice and parmesan.
Brush the sauce over the skewers while hot and top with more parmesan and parsley.
recipes.notes: Estimated recipe: the video lists the ingredients but not amounts, so quantities and macros are estimates.
